definitions: Pointed instruments used for writing, drawing, or engraving.
Small, pointed tools used to interact with touchscreens or other digital devices.
Needles or pens used in phonographs to play records.
examples: The artist used various styluses for her intricate drawings.
Many tablets come with their own styluses.
The museum displayed ancient styluses made of bone.
He replaced the worn-out styluses on his turntable.
